name: StarDrone : Sling Star
summary:
StarDrone: Sling Star is an award-winning, furiously energetic action-puzzle with a mix of arcade, pinball, breakout, and collect-the-objects. You pilot the always-in-motion space drone through diverse cosmic environments to beat each of all levels’ goals. Goals can range from getting to the end of the level alive to destroying all enemies and collecting puzzle pieces. 
StarDrone: Sling Star is an IndieCade 2011 Finalist and IMGA 2017 award nominee.
